text:
sarah: quick ping — opened PR #4920 that changes tokenizer preprocessing to NFKC normalize and adds a small safety tweak to the 7B quant profile to prevent large prealloc growth on long concatenations. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4920

akshay: taking a look now, ETA 45m. any specific edgecases you want me to check?

sarah: mainly surrogate pairs and emoji sequences that previously split oddly. also a weird case with ZWJ sequences in our chat logs. CI has a tiny bench and unit set.

mike: glanced at the profile change. 👍 Good call on reducing the prealloc ceiling. please add an inline comment in the json explaining the memory/perf tradeoff so oncall isn't surprised.

sarah: will add the comment. also added a small smoke test for ZWJ combos in tests/test_tokenizer_zwj.py — sample: 

```
# tests/test_tokenizer_zwj.py
s = "👩\u200d💻"  # woman technologist ZWJ sequence
assert tokenize(s) == ["👩\u200d💻"]
```

ci-bot: Build started for PR #4920 — matrices: ubuntu-22, py3.10, bench-small.

sarah: CI is failing in ubuntu-22 on a different unrelated integration: "ERROR tests/test_db_integration.py::test_connection - ConnectionRefusedError" — looks like a flaky infra runner.

akshay: that runner has been flaky this week. I can re-trigger the job for you. want me to do a full rebuild or just re-run the failed matrix?

sarah: re-run just the failed ubuntu-22 job if possible — we need to get this through before tonight's deploy window.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by akshay (job: ubuntu-22).

security-bot: Quick heads-up: vocab boundary changes can affect PII heuristics. @sarah please run the internal pii-detect run and paste results in the PR.

sarah: running pii-detect now, attaching results to the PR. initial local run shows no high-confidence exposures but some low-confidence tokenization diffs around emails with dots. added a note in the PR description enumerating separators we keep.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #4920.

akshay: LGTM pending your PR description note (added) and the comment in the quant profile.

mike: approved. small nit — can you squash the "fix tests" commit into the feature commit before merge? keeps history cleaner for bisecting.

sarah: squashed & merged to main. thanks y'all :tada:

jen: quick ask for release notes: can you add a 1-line blurb about tokenizer normalization and the safety quant tweak? we'll include in the deploy notes for tomorrow's window.

sarah: done. monitoring prod after deploy, will ping #eng-oncall if anything looks off.

ci-bot: Deployment scheduled for 03:00 UTC tomorrow (release calendar).
